question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **"Accomodate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's **explore** the given options:

 
 
• **Accomodate :** There is **no such word in English** or we can say that this is an **erroneous spelling.**
 
• The correct spelling is** "Accommodate(verb) " **which means **to have enough space for somebody/something, especially for a certain number of people.**
 
 
• ***​Example*: ***This lakeside view hotel can accommodate up to **450 **guests.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​*Thus, the incorrectly spelled word is 'Accomodate'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** ** Let us understand the **meaning** of the other **given words:**

 
 
• **​​Tomorrow: **the day after today.
 
• **Marathon**: a long-distance running race, in which people run about 42 kilometers or 26 miles.
 
• **Grammar**: a set of language rules that you use, most of the time unconsciously, to create phrases and sentences that convey meaning.
